name: ue-driver
summary: Shell commands to compile the project's C++, run editor Python unattended, and run the game unattended with its log checked for errors.
adapt: Add Saved/ to .gitignore if it is not there: logs go to Saved/Logs/gam3.
If the engine is not in the launcher's default location, set UE_ROOT to the engine root.

verified.how: Installed into a fresh C++ project. ue_build.mjs compiled it (ok) and refused while an editor had the project open. ue_game.mjs ran an engine template level and a built level unattended and reported shots and log problems. ue_python.mjs ran a passing script (marker found) and a failing one (reported FAILED). Windows and Linux were not run.
